title: The Marina at Brentwood Bay Resort

services.name: Small Boat Rentals
services.desc: Our small boat rentals allow you and your crew to enjoy the very best of Brentwood Bay and the Saanich Inlet from the water. Pack lunch or a snack from The Lodge and head off for an epic boating adventure! Explore local beaches, swim in the ocean and take a trip down majestic Finlayson Arm! You can even visit the world-famous Butchart Gardens by boat as part of your full-day adventure! Step aboard our boats “Eagle One” and “Golden Eagle” with friends or family and start exploring!
